svg.title: The cascade around the graph: InputLayer is the hub
svg.desc: InputLayer sits in the centre. The pipeline head (mic, VAD, streaming STT, barge-in stage, intent stage with its write gate) and the observation adapters and watchdog write facts into it as guarded programs. Rules derive claims, speech rows and work rows; standing queries push them out as inserted and retracted deltas: speech deltas to the agenda of the active speech loop (agenda, realizer, streaming TTS, pump), work deltas to a separate executor process that claims each row under a guard, runs the items in parallel against the carrier API and the order system, and writes outcomes and observations back as facts. The pump writes playback receipts. The data lane and the system lane (Interrupt) continue from the pipeline head into the speech loop beside the hub.
svg.text: Standing state → speech and work: facts in as guarded programs, conclusions out as deltas.
live knowledge graph · one graph per tenant · one revision per change

every push: inserted / retracted rows · .why on every decision
claims rows under a guard, in parallel
No audio output. Every item is a row of the
